description.en: Objective questions on types of sentences and sentence structure for Assam competitive exams.
description.as: অসম প্ৰতিযোগিতামূলক পৰীক্ষাৰ বাবে বাক্যৰ প্ৰকাৰ আৰু বাক্য গঠনৰ ওপৰত গুৰুত্বপূৰ্ণ প্ৰশ্ন।

q.en: Which type of sentence is: 'The sun rises in the east.'
q.as: 'The sun rises in the east.' — কোন প্ৰকাৰৰ বাক্য?

a.en: It makes a statement or gives information.
a.as: ই এটা বক্তব্য/তথ্য দিয়ে।

q.en: Which type of sentence is: 'Please close the door.'
q.as: 'Please close the door.' — কোন প্ৰকাৰৰ বাক্য?

a.en: It expresses a request (a kind of imperative sentence).
a.as: ই অনুৰোধ জনায় (আদেশাত্মক বাক্যৰ এটা প্ৰকাৰ)।

q.en: Which type of sentence is: 'What a beautiful picture it is!'
q.as: 'What a beautiful picture it is!' — কোন প্ৰকাৰৰ বাক্য?

a.en: It expresses a sudden feeling of wonder.
a.as: ই হঠাৎ বিস্ময়ৰ ভাৱ প্ৰকাশ কৰে।

q.en: Which type of sentence is: 'Where do you live?'
q.as: 'Where do you live?' — কোন প্ৰকাৰৰ বাক্য?

a.en: It asks a question.
a.as: ই প্ৰশ্ন সোধে।

q.en: Which type of sentence is: 'May you live long!'
q.as: 'May you live long!' — কোন প্ৰকাৰৰ বাক্য?

a.en: It expresses a wish or prayer.
a.as: ই আশীৰ্বাদ বা প্ৰাৰ্থনা প্ৰকাশ কৰে।

q.en: Which type of sentence is: 'Help me, please.'
q.as: 'Help me, please.' — কোন প্ৰকাৰৰ বাক্য?

a.en: It is a request made in the imperative form.
a.as: ই আদেশাত্মক ৰূপত দিয়া অনুৰোধ।

q.en: A sentence that asks a question is called an ___ sentence.
q.as: যি বাক্যই প্ৰশ্ন সোধে তাক ___ বাক্য বোলে।

a.en: Interrogative sentences ask questions.
a.as: প্ৰশ্নবোধক বাক্যই প্ৰশ্ন সোধে।

q.en: An assertive sentence is also called a ___ sentence.
q.as: Assertive বাক্যক আন এটা নামত ___ বাক্য বোলে।

a.en: Assertive and declarative sentences both state a fact.
a.as: Assertive আৰু declarative দুয়োটাই তথ্য/বক্তব্য প্ৰকাশ কৰে।

q.en: Which of the following is a declarative sentence?
q.as: তলৰ কোনটো এটা ঘোষণামূলক বাক্য?

a.en: It states a plain fact.
a.as: ই এটা সাধাৰণ তথ্য কয়।

q.en: Which of the following is an imperative sentence?
q.as: তলৰ কোনটো আদেশাত্মক বাক্য?

a.en: It gives a negative command (prohibition).
a.as: ই নিষেধ/আদেশ জনায়।

q.en: Change into an exclamatory sentence: 'He is a very honest man.'
q.as: বিস্ময়সূচক বাক্যলৈ ৰূপান্তৰ কৰক: 'He is a very honest man.'

options.en: What an honest man he is!
options.as: What an honest man he is!

options.en: What honest a man he is!
options.as: What honest a man he is!

a.en: Pattern: What + a/an + adjective + noun + subject + verb!
a.as: ৰীতি: What + a/an + বিশেষণ + বিশেষ্য + কৰ্তা + ক্রিয়া!

q.en: Change into an assertive sentence: 'What a beautiful flower it is!'
q.as: Assertive বাক্যলৈ ৰূপান্তৰ কৰক: 'What a beautiful flower it is!'

options.en: It is a very beautiful flower.
options.as: It is a very beautiful flower.

options.en: It is a so beautiful flower.
options.as: It is a so beautiful flower.

options.en: A very beautiful flower it is.
options.as: A very beautiful flower it is.

a.en: 'Very' is used in place of 'what a/an' in the assertive form.
a.as: Assertive ৰূপত 'what a/an' ৰ সলনি 'very' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: Change into an interrogative sentence: 'No one can deny that he is honest.'
q.as: প্ৰশ্নবোধক বাক্যলৈ ৰূপান্তৰ কৰক: 'No one can deny that he is honest.'

options.en: Can anyone deny that he is honest?
options.as: Can anyone deny that he is honest?

options.en: Can anyone deny that he is dishonest?
options.as: Can anyone deny that he is dishonest?

options.en: Can anyone deny that is he honest?
options.as: Can anyone deny that is he honest?

options.en: No one can deny that is he honest?
options.as: No one can deny that is he honest?

a.en: A negative assertive sentence turns into a positive interrogative one.
a.as: নকাৰাত্মক assertive বাক্য সকাৰাত্মক প্ৰশ্নবোধক বাক্যলৈ ৰূপান্তৰিত হয়।

q.en: Change into an assertive sentence: 'Am I a fool?'
q.as: Assertive বাক্যলৈ ৰূপান্তৰ কৰক: 'Am I a fool?'

a.en: This rhetorical question means a negative assertion.
a.as: এই অলংকাৰিক প্ৰশ্নটোৱে নকাৰাত্মক বক্তব্য বুজায়।

q.en: Change into an imperative sentence: 'You should not waste time.'
q.as: আদেশাত্মক বাক্যলৈ ৰূপান্তৰ কৰক: 'You should not waste time.'

a.en: A prohibition is expressed with 'Do not + base verb'.
a.as: নিষেধ 'Do not + মূল ক্রিয়া' ৰে প্ৰকাশ হয়।

q.en: Which of the following is an optative sentence?
q.as: তলৰ কোনটো আশীৰ্বাদসূচক বাক্য?

a.en: It expresses a blessing/prayer.
a.as: ই আশীৰ্বাদ/প্ৰাৰ্থনা প্ৰকাশ কৰে।

q.en: Which of the following is an exclamatory sentence?
q.as: তলৰ কোনটো বিস্ময়সূচক বাক্য?

a.en: It shows a sudden feeling using 'How'.
a.as: 'How' ৰে হঠাৎ ভাৱ প্ৰকাশ হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'An imperative sentence expresses a ___, a request or advice.'
q.as: শূন্যস্থান পূৰণ কৰক: 'An imperative sentence expresses a ___, a request or advice.'

a.en: Imperative sentences express commands, requests or advice.
a.as: আদেশাত্মক বাক্যই আদেশ, অনুৰোধ বা উপদেশ প্ৰকাশ কৰে।

q.en: 'Don't waste time.' is a ___ sentence.
q.as: 'Don't waste time.' এটা ___ বাক্য।

a.en: It is a command in the negative form.
a.as: ই নকাৰাত্মক ৰূপত দিয়া আদেশ।

q.en: A sentence which expresses a sudden strong feeling is called a/an ___ sentence.
q.as: যি বাক্যই হঠাৎ প্ৰবল ভাৱ প্ৰকাশ কৰে তাক ___ বাক্য বোলে।

a.en: Sudden feelings (joy, sorrow, wonder) are expressed by exclamatory sentences.
a.as: আনন্দ, দুখ, বিস্ময় আদি হঠাৎ ভাৱ বিস্ময়সূচক বাক্যত প্ৰকাশ পায়।

q.en: A sentence that has only one subject and one finite verb is called a ___ sentence.
q.as: যি বাক্যত কেৱল এটা subject আৰু এটা finite verb থাকে তাক ___ বাক্য বোলে।

a.en: A simple sentence has one main clause only.
a.as: সৰল বাক্যত কেৱল এটা main clause থাকে।

q.en: A sentence that has two or more main clauses joined by a conjunction is a ___ sentence.
q.as: যি বাক্যত conjunction ৰে যুক্ত দুটা বা তাতকৈ বেছি main clause থাকে তাক ___ বাক্য বোলে।

a.en: A compound sentence joins main clauses with and/but/or.
a.as: যৌগিক বাক্যত and/but/or ৰে main clause যুক্ত হয়।

q.en: A sentence that has one main clause and one or more subordinate clauses is a ___ sentence.
q.as: যি বাক্যত এটা main clause আৰু এটা বা বেছি subordinate clause থাকে তাক ___ বাক্য বোলে।

a.en: A complex sentence contains a subordinate clause.
a.as: জটিল বাক্যত subordinate clause থাকে।

q.en: Identify the kind of sentence: 'He came home and slept.'
q.as: বাক্যটোৰ প্ৰকাৰ চিনাক্ত কৰক: 'He came home and slept.'

a.en: Two main clauses are joined by 'and'.
a.as: 'and' ৰে দুটা main clause যুক্ত হৈছে।

q.en: Identify the kind of sentence: 'He is so weak that he cannot walk.'
q.as: বাক্যটোৰ প্ৰকাৰ চিনাক্ত কৰক: 'He is so weak that he cannot walk.'

a.en: Main clause + subordinate clause ('that he cannot walk').
a.as: Main clause + subordinate clause ('that he cannot walk')।

q.en: Identify the kind of sentence: 'He is too weak to walk.'
q.as: বাক্যটোৰ প্ৰকাৰ চিনাক্ত কৰক: 'He is too weak to walk.'

a.en: The phrase 'too...to' has no finite verb, so it is a simple sentence.
a.as: 'too...to' অংশত finite verb নাই, সেয়ে ই সৰল বাক্য।

q.en: Identify the kind of sentence: 'I know that he is honest.'
q.as: বাক্যটোৰ প্ৰকাৰ চিনাক্ত কৰক: 'I know that he is honest.'

a.en: It has a main clause and a noun clause ('that he is honest').
a.as: ইয়াত main clause আৰু noun clause আছে।

q.en: Identify the kind of sentence: 'Work hard or you will fail.'
q.as: বাক্যটোৰ প্ৰকাৰ চিনাক্ত কৰক: 'Work hard or you will fail.'

a.en: Two clauses are joined by 'or'.
a.as: 'or' ৰে দুটা clause যুক্ত হৈছে।

q.en: Identify the kind of sentence: 'The boy who stole the pen was punished.'
q.as: বাক্যটোৰ প্ৰকাৰ চিনাক্ত কৰক: 'The boy who stole the pen was punished.'

a.en: It contains an adjective clause ('who stole the pen').
a.as: ইয়াত adjective clause আছে ('who stole the pen')।

q.en: Which of the following is a simple sentence?
q.as: তলৰ কোনটো সৰল বাক্য?

options.en: Being ill, he stayed at home.
options.as: Being ill, he stayed at home.

options.en: As he was ill, he stayed at home.
options.as: As he was ill, he stayed at home.

options.en: He was ill and so he stayed at home.
options.as: He was ill and so he stayed at home.

a.en: Option B has only one subject and one finite verb ('being ill' is a phrase).
a.as: B বিকল্পত মাত্ৰ এটা subject আৰু finite verb আছে।

q.en: Change into a simple sentence: 'As he was ill, he stayed at home.'
q.as: সৰল বাক্যলৈ ৰূপান্তৰ কৰক: 'As he was ill, he stayed at home.'

options.en: Being ill, he stayed at home.
options.as: Being ill, he stayed at home.

options.en: He was ill and stayed at home.
options.as: He was ill and stayed at home.

options.en: He stayed at home and was ill.
options.as: He stayed at home and was ill.

options.en: He was ill so he stayed at home.
options.as: He was ill so he stayed at home.

a.en: The adverb clause becomes a participle phrase 'being ill'.
a.as: Adverb clause টো 'being ill' participle phrase লৈ ৰূপান্তৰিত হয়।

q.en: Change into a compound sentence: 'He must work hard to pass.'
q.as: যৌগিক বাক্যলৈ ৰূপান্তৰ কৰক: 'He must work hard to pass.'

options.en: He must work hard or he will not pass.
options.as: He must work hard or he will not pass.

options.en: He must work hard and pass.
options.as: He must work hard and pass.

options.en: If he works hard, he will pass.
options.as: If he works hard, he will pass.

a.en: The infinitive 'to pass' is converted into a second clause with 'or'.
a.as: 'to pass' ৰ সলনি 'or' ৰে দ্বিতীয় clause তৈয়াৰ হয়।

q.en: Change into a complex sentence: 'Work hard and you will pass.'
q.as: জটিল বাক্যলৈ ৰূপান্তৰ কৰক: 'Work hard and you will pass.'

options.en: If you work hard, you will pass.
options.as: If you work hard, you will pass.

options.en: By working hard you will pass.
options.as: By working hard you will pass.

a.en: The first clause becomes an adverb clause of condition 'If...'.
a.as: প্ৰথম clause টো 'If...' শর্তবোধক adverb clause হয়।

q.en: The part of the sentence about which something is said is called the ___.
q.as: যি অংশৰ বিষয়ে বাক্যটোত কোৱা হয় তাকে ___ বোলে।

a.en: The subject is the doer that the sentence is about.
a.as: Subject হৈছে বাক্যটো যি বিষয়ে কোৱা হয় সেই কৰ্তা।

q.en: The part of the sentence that says something about the subject is the ___.
q.as: বাক্যৰ যি অংশই subject ৰ বিষয়ে কয় তাক ___ বোলে।

a.en: The predicate begins with the verb.
a.as: Predicate ক্রিয়াৰে আৰম্ভ হয়।

q.en: Identify the subject in: 'The old man walks slowly.'
q.as: কৰ্তা চিনাক্ত কৰক: 'The old man walks slowly.'

a.en: 'The old man' is who the sentence talks about.
a.as: 'The old man' হৈছে বাক্যটোৰ মূল বিষয়।

q.en: A group of words without a finite verb is called a ___.
q.as: finite verb নথকা শব্দসমষ্টিক ___ বোলে।

a.en: A phrase has no subject-finite verb combination.
a.as: Phrase ত subject-finite verb নাথাকে।

q.en: A group of words that has a subject and a finite verb but forms only part of a sentence is a ___.
q.as: subject আৰু finite verb থকা কিন্তু বাক্যৰ অংশ মাথোন হোৱা শব্দসমষ্টি এটা ___।

a.en: A clause is part of a sentence but has its own subject and verb.
a.as: Clause ৰ নিজস্ব subject-verb থাকে যদিও সি বাক্যৰ অংশহে।

q.en: A group of words that makes complete sense is a ___.
q.as: যি শব্দসমষ্টিয়ে সম্পূৰ্ণ অৰ্থ প্ৰকাশ কৰে তাক ___ বোলে।

a.en: A sentence expresses a complete thought.
a.as: বাক্যই সম্পূৰ্ণ ভাৱ প্ৰকাশ কৰে।

q.en: Which of the following is a phrase?
q.as: তলৰ কোনটো এটা phrase (বাক্যাংশ)?

a.en: The other options have their own subjects and verbs.
a.as: আনবোৰ বিকল্পৰ নিজস্ব subject-verb আছে।

q.en: Which of the following is a complete sentence?
q.as: তলৰ কোনটো সম্পূৰ্ণ বাক্য?

a.en: Only option B has a subject and a verb and makes complete sense.
a.as: B বিকল্পতহে subject-verb আছে আৰু সম্পূৰ্ণ অৰ্থ দিয়ে।

q.en: What kind of sentence is: 'How beautiful the sunset is!'
q.as: 'How beautiful the sunset is!' — কোন প্ৰকাৰৰ বাক্য?

a.en: An exclamatory sentence (expresses wonder).
a.as: বিস্ময়সূচক বাক্য (বিস্ময় প্ৰকাশ কৰে)।
